title: Salesforce Lands $1.6B Veterans Affairs Agreement as AI Adoption Accelerates
excerpt: Salesforce, Inc. shares are up during Friday’s premarket session as the company has won a $1.6 billion contract from the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs...
content_html:

Salesforce, Inc. shares are up during Friday's premarket session as the company has won a $1.6 billion contract from the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) to enhance its services.

This agreement is expected to leverage Salesforce's technology to streamline operations and improve care delivery for veterans, which could significantly impact the company's revenue and market position moving forward.

Wins $1.6 Billion VA Contract

The VA's contract is structured as a one-year Agentic Enterprise License Agreement (AELA) with options for two additional one-year renewals.

Don't Miss:

  • A single bad hire can set a startup back years. Here are the 5 hires founders most often misjudge — and why

  • Still Learning the Market? These 50 Must-Know Terms Can Help You Catch Up Fast

It aims to modernize care and service delivery for over 17 million veterans.

This partnership builds on a long-standing relationship and is designed to reduce administrative burdens, allowing VA employees to focus more on serving veterans effectively.

Commits $1 Billion to Switzerland to Accelerate Agentic AI Push

This month, Salesforce announced Tuesday that it will invest $1 billion in Switzerland over the next five years to accelerate the country's adoption of agentic artificial intelligence.

CEO Marc Benioff unveiled the investment ahead of the AI for Good Global Summit in Geneva. The funding will support Salesforce's local workforce, customers, partners and AI skills development across Switzerland.

CRM Technical Outlook: Trend, Momentum And Key Levels

Currently, Salesforce, Inc. is trading at $159.35, which places it about 3.4% below its 20-day simple moving average (SMA) of $164.65. The stock has been underperforming, with its 50-day SMA at $170.33, indicating a bearish trend as the 20-day SMA is below the 50-day SMA.

Trending: Avoid the #1 Investing Mistake: How Your 'Safe' Holdings Could Be Costing You Big Time

Momentum indicators show that the MACD is currently above its signal line, suggesting that downside pressure is easing, although the overall trend remains bearish. This indicates a potential for a reversal or stabilization in the near term, especially with the positive news surrounding the VA contract.

  • Key Resistance: $170.00 — a critical level where the stock has faced selling pressure in the past.

  • Key Support: $156.50 — a level where buyers previously stepped in, providing a safety net for the stock.

Salesforce, Inc. 的股价在周五盘前交易中上涨，因为该公司从美国退伍军人事务部 (VA) 赢得了一份价值 16 亿美元的合同，以增强其服务。

该协议预计将利用 Salesforce 的技术来简化运营并改善退伍军人的护理服务，这可能会对公司未来的收入和市场地位产生重大影响。

赢得价值 16 亿美元的 VA 合同

VA 的合同采用为期一年的代理企业许可协议 (AELA)，并可选择两次额外的一年续约。

不要错过：

  • 一次糟糕的招聘可能会让一家初创企业倒退数年。 以下是创始人最常误判的 5 名员工——以及原因

它旨在为超过 1700 万退伍军人提供现代化的护理和服务。

这种伙伴关系建立在长期关系的基础上，旨在减轻行政负担，使 VA 员工能够更加专注于有效地为退伍军人服务。

向瑞士投入 10 亿美元，加速 Agentic AI 的发展

本月，Salesforce 周二宣布，未来五年将在瑞士投资 10 亿美元，以加速该国对代理人工智能的采用。

首席执行官马克·贝尼奥夫 (Marc Benioff) 在日内瓦 AI for Good 全球峰会之前公布了这项投资。 这笔资金将支持 Salesforce 在瑞士各地的当地员工、客户、合作伙伴和人工智能技能开发。

CRM 技术展望：趋势、动力和关键水平

目前，Salesforce, Inc. 的交易价格为 159.35 美元，比 164.65 美元的 20 天简单移动平均线 (SMA) 低约 3.4%。 该股表现不佳，50 日移动平均线为 170.33 美元，表明看跌趋势，因为 20 日移动平均线低于 50 日移动平均线。

趋势：避免第一大投资错误：你的“安全”持仓可能会让你付出巨大的代价

动能指标显示MACD目前位于信号线上方，表明下行压力正在缓解，但总体趋势仍看跌。 这表明短期内有可能出现逆转或稳定，尤其是在 VA 合同的积极消息传出的情况下。

  • 主要阻力位：170.00 美元——该股过去曾面临抛售压力的关键水平。
  • 关键支撑位：156.50 美元——买家此前介入的水平，为该股提供了安全网。
